```{r results='asis'}
days <- data.frame(
  slug = c("day-1", "day-2", "day-3", "day-4", "day-5"),
  label = c("Day 1", "Day 2", "Day 3", "Day 4", "Day 5"),
  date = c(
    "Monday 6 July 2026",
    "Tuesday 7 July 2026",
    "Wednesday 8 July 2026",
    "Thursday 9 July 2026",
    "Friday 10 July 2026"
  ),
  file = c(
    "data/day1.csv",
    "data/day2.csv",
    "data/day3.csv",
    "data/day4.csv",
    "data/day5.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

read_day <- function(path) {
  read.csv(
    path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("", "NA")
  )
}

type_class <- function(value) {
  value <- tolower(value)
  value <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", value)
  gsub("(^-+|-+$)", "", value)
}

escape_html <- function(value, attribute = FALSE) {
  if (length(value) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  value[is.na(value)] <- ""
  htmltools::htmlEscape(value, attribute = attribute)
}

split_details <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  parts <- trimws(strsplit(value, "\\|\\|")[[1]])
  parts[nzchar(parts)]
}

render_details <- function(value) {
  items <- split_details(value)

  if (!length(items)) {
    return("")
  }

  paste0(
    '<ul class="session-details">',
    paste0(sprintf("<li>%s</li>", escape_html(items)), collapse = ""),
    "</ul>"
  )
}

render_location <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
    return("")
  }

  sprintf(
    '<div class="session-location">%s</div>',
    escape_html(value)
  )
}

render_link <- function(value, session_type) {
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
    return("")
  }

  label <- if (identical(tolower(session_type), "visit")) {
    "Visit details"
  } else {
    "Session details"
  }

  sprintf(
    '<a class="session-link" href="%s">%s</a>',
    escape_html(value, attribute = TRUE),
    label
  )
}

render_session <- function(row) {
  session_type <- if (is.na(row[["Type"]]) || !nzchar(row[["Type"]])) "Session" else row[["Type"]]
  session_class <- type_class(session_type)

  paste0(
    '<article class="session-card type-', session_class, '">',
    '<div class="session-time">', escape_html(row[["Time"]]), '</div>',
    '<div class="session-content">',
    '<div class="session-meta">',
    '<span class="session-badge">', escape_html(session_type), '</span>',
    render_location(row[["Location"]]),
    '</div>',
    '<h3 class="session-title">', escape_html(row[["Title"]]), '</h3>',
    render_details(row[["Details"]]),
    render_link(row[["Link"]], session_type),
    '</div>',
    '</article>'
  )
}

schedule_data <- lapply(days$file, read_day)
total_sessions <- sum(vapply(schedule_data, nrow, integer(1)))

nav_links <- paste0(
  sprintf(
    '<a href="#%s" class="program-nav-link">%s</a>',
    days$slug,
    days$label
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

day_sections <- character(nrow(days))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(days))) {
  day_rows <- schedule_data[[i]]
  sessions <- paste0(
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(day_rows)), function(j) render_session(day_rows[j, ]), character(1)),
    collapse = ""
  )

  day_sections[i] <- paste0(
    '<section id="', days$slug[i], '" class="program-day">',
    '<div class="day-heading">',
    '<div>',
    '<p class="day-label">', escape_html(days$label[i]), '</p>',
    '<h2>', escape_html(days$date[i]), '</h2>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="day-count">', nrow(day_rows), ' sessions</div>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="session-list">',
    sessions,
    '</div>',
    '</section>'
  )
}

cat(
  paste0(
    '<div id="top" class="page-container program-page">',
    '<div class="section-header program-header">',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="program-summary">',
    '<div class="summary-card"><span class="summary-label">Dates</span><span class="summary-value">6-10 July 2026</span></div>',
    '<div class="summary-card"><span class="summary-label">Location</span><span class="summary-value">Cardiff University</span></div>',
    '<div class="summary-card"><span class="summary-label">Sessions</span><span class="summary-value">', total_sessions, '</span></div>',
    '</div>',
    '<nav class="program-nav">', nav_links, '</nav>',
    paste0(day_sections, collapse = ""),
    '</div>'
  )
)
```
